Unfortunately, same-day delivery is not something we offer. According to our shipping policy (kb/02-shipping-policy.md), we only offer the following shipping methods:

- **Standard Ground**: 5–7 business days — $5.95 (free on orders over $75)
- **Expedited**: 2–3 business days — $12.95
- **Overnight**: Next business day (order placed by 1 PM local time) — $24.95

Our fastest option is **Overnight shipping**, which delivers the next business day when you order by 1 PM local time. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!

Generally, **only one promo code can be applied per order** — unless a specific promotion explicitly states otherwise. You can find this noted on the checkout page, which will also indicate if a code is valid for the items in your cart.

Per **kb/11-promotions.md**, if you're trying to combine a promo code with a sale price, most codes cannot be stacked with sale or clearance pricing either.

If you have a specific promotion in mind that mentions it can be combined, that would be the exception! Otherwise, you'll need to choose the one code that gives you the best deal. Let me know if you have any other questions!
